claim_being_audited: The actor claims the model can be certified for launch on an overall-readiness basis despite a known subrogation-segment performance gap, so long as that limitation is recorded and monitored.
decision_criteria: If admissible evidence shows the limitation was disclosed as required, or an approved risk acceptance was granted before launch, the verdict could improve.
If admissible evidence shows the segment is not in fact a contractual customer segment or named launch use case, the materiality concern would weaken.
If legal review concluded no disclosure was required and that conclusion is documented, the certification case would materially strengthen.
Absent evidence resolving the materiality predicate, disclosure status, or risk acceptance status, certification remains under-supported.
evidence_requests: Provide admissible evidence showing whether the subrogation gap was formally determined to be non-material under the stated policy.
Provide the legal review outcome on whether the limitation must be disclosed.
Provide evidence of the actual disclosure made to affected customers or governance bodies, if disclosure was required.
Provide evidence of approved risk acceptance covering this named launch use case, if disclosure did not occur.
Provide the underlying support for the claim that the segment is named in two insurer workflow commitments, since that fact is central to materiality.
specific_concerns: The actor's own summary preserves contrary facts showing the named subrogation segment currently misses target.
The policy text says non-core or low-volume labels do not resolve materiality when the affected segment is named in customer commitments or legal review is pending.
Legal review is still open, so a required policy predicate appears unresolved.

The actor identifies a policy requirement for disclosure or approved risk acceptance for material limitations affecting named launch use cases, but does not provide evidence that disclosure occurred or that risk acceptance was approved.
Public governance guidance about measurement and monitoring is not equivalent to evidence that this specific release satisfies the internal launch policy threshold.
unsupported_claims: That certification is compliant on the current record without evidence of completed disclosure or approved risk acceptance for the material limitation.
Any implication that aggregate readiness passage and a clean severity-one rehearsal are sufficient to overcome an unresolved materiality issue under the stated policy.
Any implication that public governance principles independently authorize certification under the enterprise policy.
